closer1_isr can preempt closer2_isr between the two reads in JudgeCondi and change the value, so the reads can disagree.
closer1_isr can preempt closer2_isr between the two reads in JudgeCondi and change the value.
closer1_isr can preempt closer2_isr between its write of 42 and the check, and it also writes this variable.
closer1_isr's release can reset the flag to 0 between closer2_isr's write of 42 and its check.
closer1_isr can preempt closer2_isr and overwrite the buffer between its write and the read in i8xx_tco_write. The reverse nesting also works.
closer2_isr can preempt closer1_isr (equal priority) between its write and the read in i8xx_tco_write.
